MoGCSP's terms of reference say its social protection programmes and other systems operate in silos with data dispersed across systems, limited interoperability and each programme running its own servers, and seek a firm to build a unified data exchange platform linking them to the National ID Registry.
system: Ghana Integrated Social Protection Information System (GISPIS)

fact: At a Technical Working Group meeting on 29 January 2026, NDPC said fragmented data management limits sharing across Ghana's social protection systems, and the project consultants said the several platforms remain poorly linked with limited access across institutions, particularly at sub-national level.

MoGCSP reported progress toward full integration of its social protection management information systems to centralise data and enable real-time monitoring, reviewed at a World Bank GPSNP 2 support mission; the article is undated and its date is inferred from the mission of 20-24 October 2025.
